note: The bandit window («Записи братви»): the neutral notebook's messy twin -- the same spread on the desk, crumpled, bent and torn. Left page ruled: the title with a struck word, the pot counted in tally marks, the entry of the selected node; right page squared: the tree of torn scraps growing down, links from the hand. Root TreeWindow fills the screen with the desk; TreeStage is the mockup's 1600x900 stage, centred. The pages are one picture (Spread) under the live widgets; roles the menu fills are listed in source/ui/SKINS.md; numbers are the mockup's, measured in Chrome.

image.name: TreeDesk
image.note: Wood, tiled at its own size over the whole screen.

image.name: SpreadShadow
image.note: The notebook's shadow on the desk, along its torn edges.

image.name: Spread
image.note: The spread as the mockup draws it: the ruled left page and the squared right one, crumpled (soft light), bent (the page warp), torn, the spine on its staples.

panel.name: PageL
panel.note: The left page: everything on it is live; the page itself (ruled, crumpled, torn) is in the Spread picture under it.

icon.name: TitleImg
icon.note: «Дерево ~~знань~~ досліджень» with the struck word, bent with the page: the skin loads the picture of the player's language (STR_OZL_SKIN_BANDIT_TITLE_IMG) in OnShow.

label.name: TitleText
label.note: Shown only if the title picture can not be loaded: the title without the struck word.

label.name: DevName
label.note: 3 units past the mockup's right edge, so the slanted last glyph is not cut by the box.

icon.name: PoolHeadImg
icon.note: «Общак» with its wavy underline, bent with the page: the skin loads STR_OZL_SKIN_BANDIT_POOL_IMG in OnShow.

label.name: PoolHeadText
label.note: Shown only if the heading picture can not be loaded.

raw.name: PoolScroll
raw.note: Five lines on the ruling, with room under the last one for the double underline of a big number; a faction with more lines scrolls, its bar in pencil (colour + style blank: thumb in the colour, track at half). The row template is declared on TreeTemplates.

raw.name: CardBody
raw.note: Does not clip: the button moves 5 units left of it, and its ink ring sticks out.

raw.name: CardScroll
raw.note: The node's entry, top to bottom; the engine stacks it and a long entry scrolls above the button, its bar in pencil. The rows of CardCostList, CardItemList and CardOpensList are declared on TreeTemplates.

panel.name: CardNameRow
panel.note: The name and its wavy underline (wave_name, clipped to the name by CardNameWave, which the skin sizes).

stack.name: CardMeta
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines (bitmap fonts: no MultilineTextWidget).

stack.name: CardDesc
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into CardDesc0..9, 32 apart like the ruling, 9 units in (.card > div:nth-child(2n)): each line sits in a holder CardDescRow<i>, which the skin shows and hides with its line (a stack can not move a child sideways).

panel.name: CardCostHeadRow
panel.note: The cost block sits 5 units left in the mockup, which cuts the first letter there (the card clips); here the heads stay at 0 and only the cost lines move.

panel.name: CardItemsHeadRow
panel.note: Shown with CardItemsHead (the skin follows the menu).

panel.name: CardTimeHeadRow
panel.note: The time block sits 9 units in (.card > div:nth-child(2n)).

frame.name: CardSegs
frame.note: The 20 segments of a running project: an underline each, red when done (.pbar of the paper block), 9 units in.

panel.name: CardOpensHeadRow
panel.note: Shown with CardOpensHead (the skin follows the menu).

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The menu lines the 'opens' chips up here (ozl_bandit_opens_chip) and sets the height to what they take.

raw.name: CardFoot
raw.note: The button and the reason under it, from 5 units left of the card to its right end: the mockup's foot is the card's 6th block when the node opens something (.card > div:nth-child(3n) { margin-left: -5px }), the usual case; a node that opens nothing has it 5 narrower on the left there. Does not clip: the ink ring sticks out.

icon.name: BtnResearchHover
icon.note: The pale ink inside the drawn ring under an enabled button the mouse is over.

icon.name: BtnResearchRing
icon.note: Circled in ink: shown while the button is enabled.

raw.name: BtnResearch
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

panel.name: BtnResearchStrike
panel.note: Strikes the words of a disabled button; the skin sizes it to the words.

panel.name: PageR
panel.note: The right page: the tree; the page itself (squared, crumpled, torn) is in the Spread picture under it.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The tree: drag it, or the wheel. The menu sizes TreeContent. Colour + style blank draw the bars in pencil (thumb in the colour, track at half), like neutral's.

raw.name: TreeLines
raw.note: Every link, drawn by the menu from the hand (LineStyle sketch); the squares are in the page picture.

image.name: TreeFogEdge
image.note: The fade into the fog, crumpled like the page, with the mockup's faint 135-degree stripes showing through it; its own colours (the skin's FogColor is white).

image.name: TreeFog
image.note: The fog, crumpled like the page; its own colours.

label.name: TreeTipText
label.note: Wider than any tip on purpose: the menu sizes TreeTip from the text (GetTextSize) and TreeTip clips the rest; a label sized to its text would clip the top of a slanted last letter.

image.name: TearR
image.note: The desk where the torn right edge and the torn-off corner took the paper away: over the tree's right end, so its fog, scraps and scrollbars end at the tear as the mockup's clip-path ends them. 2 units wider than the page's rest (760): the picture's last 2 columns are clear, so the texture's wrap leaves no seam on its first; they lie past the tree's 760, over the same desk.

raw.name: BtnClose
raw.note: Not in the mockup: the paper has no frame to close, so a pencilled word in the corner, under the tape.

label.name: BtnCloseText
label.note: 3 units short of the button's edge: the slanted last letter must not reach it.

list.name: BranchScroll
list.note: Only when the faction has more than one branch (the skin shows it).

row.name: OZL_BanditBranchRow
row.note: A branch: RowHit is clicked (the menu renames it branch:<id>); the open one is underlined in red.

frame.name: TreeLegend
frame.note: The dashed line over it is in the page picture.

panel.name: LegendRow
panel.note: Lined up by the skin (FlowLater from OnShow) by the width of each item's TEXT plus 14: the labels are wider than their text, because a label sized to its text clips the top of a slanted last letter.

list.name: TreeTemplates
list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the row files of the lists that are raw scrolls (pool, card) and those the menu creates outside the lists.

row.name: OZL_BanditPoolRow
row.note: One line of the pot (.prow of the paper block): the name, the tally marks, the number at the right. The skin (PaintPoolRow) puts the marks (TallyMark0..7: tens as crossed squares, a five as four struck bars, the rest as bars) into PoolTally, shifts the line as the mockup's nth-child margins do (PoolLine down, PoolShift sideways: the number stays at the right), strikes a zero through, and shows a number over 60 big and double-underlined (PoolValueBig, PoolValueLine1/2) instead of marks.

panel.name: PoolLine
panel.note: Everything of the line; the skin moves it down by the margins of the rows above (2 units every third row).

panel.name: PoolShift
panel.note: The name, its strike and the marks: what the mockup's padding-left moves; the skin moves only this.

label.name: PoolName
label.note: Wider than the 190 of the mockup's .pn: a TextWidget clips its text at its box.

panel.name: PoolTally
panel.note: The marks, placed by the skin: x from the mockup's flex row (gap 10, a ten 20 wide with 2 of margin each side).

label.name: PoolValue
label.note: Ends 3 units short of the line: the list clips at the line's end (stand 2026-10-31: a 0 there lost its right half), and Caveat's last digit reaches past its advance.

label.name: PoolValueBig
label.note: A number over 60 (.prow.many .pv): 34 px instead of 26.

panel.name: PoolValueLine1
panel.note: The double underline of a big number (underline double, 4 px below), sized to it by the skin.

row.name: OZL_BanditCostRow
row.note: A cost line of the card: the name and 'have / need' (or 'need' alone when paid or not known); what is short is underlined. 26 high plus the 2 the mockup leaves between the lines of a block. The cost block of the card sits 5 units left (.card > div:nth-child(3n)), so the name starts at 3, not 8, and the number ends 5 units short of the edge.

label.name: CostValue
label.note: Ends 2 units short of the edge (5 for the block's shift, 3 back so the slanted last glyph is not cut by the box).

row.name: OZL_BanditOpensChip
row.note: A node this one opens: a word with a dashed underline. The menu lines the chips up and stretches ChipHit and ChipLine to each chip's width; a hidden node's chip has no ChipHit.

raw.name: ChipHit
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

label.name: ChipText
label.note: Wider than any chip text on purpose: a label sized to its text clips the slanted last letter; FlowLater lines the chips up by GetTextSize, not by this box.

row.name: OZL_BanditTierLabel
row.note: A tier label; the menu puts the row's corner on the label's centre.

row.name: OZL_BanditOrLabel
row.note: The 'АБО' beside an 'any' diamond; the menu puts the row's corner on the diamond and colours the word like its line.

row.name: OZL_BanditPriceChip
row.note: One line of a node's price: its coloured dot and the amount. The menu lines them up in NodePrice.

label.name: PriceText
label.note: Wider than any amount on purpose (the slanted last digit); FlowLater lines the chips up by GetTextSize and NodePrice clips the rest.

icon.name: BlotA
icon.note: The ink blots, the doodles of the margins and the tape lie over everything and take no mouse.

icon.name: Tape
icon.note: A strip of tape over the corner of the right page.
